description: Make a live request to a dataandapis.com API with the user's API key (sent as X-Api-Key on this MCP connection). Give the API slug, the endpoint path from get_api (path parameters already filled in, e.g. '/v1/products/3017620422003'), optional query parameters and, for POST, a JSON body. Most calls cost 1 token.

path.description: Endpoint path such as '/v1/screen'. A leading '/v1' is added when missing.

name: call_api
title: Call an API endpoint
